 1                   I.      INTRODUCTION AND QUALIFICATIONS

 2   Q1.   PLEASE STATE YOUR NAME, BUSINESS ADDRESS.

 3   A.    My name is Rene F. Gonzalez. My business address is 100 North Stanton Street,

 4         El Paso, Texas, 79901.

 5

 6   Q2.   ON WHOSE BEHALF ARE YOU SUBMITTING THIS TESTIMONY

 7   A.    I am filing this testimony on behalf of El Paso Electric Company (“EPE” or “the

 8         Company”).

 9

10   Q3.   HAVE YOU PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED TESTIMONY IN THIS

11         PROCEEDING?

12   A.    Yes. I submitted Direct Testimony in this proceeding on March 27, 2026.

13

16         TESTIMONY?

 3                                   HEARING BENCH REQUEST

 4   Q5.   WHAT HAS THE COMMISSION REQUESTED IN PARAGRAPH 9.a OF

 5         THE PRE-HEARING BENCH REQUEST?

 6   A.    Paragraph 9.a of the Pre-Hearing Bench Request requests “[t]he number of kilowatt

 7         hours (kWh) consumed per month and (if applicable) demand (kW) metered per

 8         month, by an average-use customer within each of EPE’s customer classes.”

 9

10   Q6.   IN RESPONSE TO PARAGRAPH 9.a., PROVIDE THE NUMBER OF

11         KILOWATT HOURS (kWh) CONSUMED PER MONTH AND (IF

12         APPLICABLE) DEMAND (kW) METERED PER MONTH, BY AN

13         AVERAGE-USE CUSTOMER WITHIN EACH OF EPE’S CUSTOMER

14         CLASSES.

15   A.    Please see Exhibit RFG-1S for average consumption amounts for both kWh and

16         kW (where appliable). Please note that this data is reflected as Historical Test Year

17         Period data (i.e. as adjusted from the Base Period). Annual amounts for kWh,

18         reconcilable to this response, were also provided with my direct testimony in

   DECLARATION OF RENE F. GONZALEZ IN SUPPORT OF THE FOREGOING
            AMENDED FILING SUPPLEMENTAL TESTIMONY

       I, Rene F. Gonzalez, pursuant to Rule 1-011 NMRA, state as follows:

       1.      I affirm in writing under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of

New Mexico that the following statements are true and correct.

       2.      I am over 18 years of age and have personal knowledge of the facts stated herein.

I am employed by El Paso Electric Company ("EPE" or “the Company”) as the Supervisor – Rates

and Regulatory.

       3.      I have reviewed the foregoing Amended Filing Supplemental Testimony of Rene

F. Gonzalez, and the exhibits, schedules, and workpapers sponsored by me and I confirm, to the

best of my knowledge, that those materials are complete, accurate, internally consistent, and

consistent with the Amended Application.

       4.      The foregoing Amended Filing Supplemental Testimony of Rene F. Gonzalez,

together with all exhibits sponsored therein and attached thereto, is true and accurate based on my

knowledge and belief.

       5.      I submit this Declaration, based upon my personal knowledge and upon information

and belief, in support of EPE’s Amended Application for Revisions of Its Retail Electric Rates

Pursuant to Advice Notice No. 317.
